message: No drinking-water pipeline geometries were provided by Member 1. BluePulse never fabricates water-network coordinates.

sewer_inp_coordinate_metadata.note: bluepulse_sewer.inp currently uses schematic 'Units None' map coordinates. To compute real-world proximity, provide georeferenced GeoJSON geometries with an explicit CRS (e.g., EPSG:4326 or local UTM EPSG) for both networks.
